title: Velvety Russian Panna Cotta
description: A creamy dessert made with Russian velvety sugar and a touch of sweetness.
instructions: In a small bowl, sprinkle gelatin over 1/4 cup of cold water and let it sit for 5 minutes.
In a medium saucepan, combine milk, heavy cream, and sugar. Heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar dissolves and the mixture is hot but not boiling.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and add the gelatin mixture, stirring until it's fully dissolved.
Add the vanilla extract and stir to combine.
Pour the mixture into individual serving cups or a large serving dish.
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours or until set.
Serve chilled, garnished with fresh fruit or a sprinkle of sugar.
